messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod blocked: artifact staging failed for release v2.14.0 -> staging upload returned 422 checksum_mismatch for blob uploads
maria: saw this in the dashboard too, staging indexer shows repeated multipart aborts :confused:
kevin: logs from storage-proxy: "403 SignedURLExpired" right after the second chunk, looks like token rotation hit active uploads
sasha: if signed URLs are expiring mid-upload that explains checksum mismatch - client retries produce different order? weird but plausible
samir: can't promote until artifact verifies, we should either reupload or pin to last-good. what's last-good digest?
maria: last-good image digest is sha256:7f8d9cabc (promoted yesterday). we can pin and re-promote if ops agrees
jen: pin + note in release notes + followup ticket for signed-url TTL. prefer pin now to meet change window :thumbsup:
kevin: propose plan:
- pin release to sha256:7f8d9cabc (manual promote)
- mark current staging artifact as "upload-failed" and disable auto-promote
- open ticket to increase signed-url TTL and add monitoring for in-progress uploads
sasha: command to pin:
```
deployctl promote --image=sha256:7f8d9cabc --to=prod --by=maria --note="pin due to staging multipart/ttl"
```
maria: doing the promote now, will annotate the release notes and add a rollback entry
maria: @ops-bot please run promote
ops-bot: Received promote request from maria, executing step 1/3...
ops-bot: Promote successful, prod now at sha256:7f8d9cabc :white_check_mark:
samir: ok unblocked. can someone take the signed-url TTL ticket? assigning to kevin for follow-up
kevin: taking it, will add replication tests to catch mid-upload expiry and queue a postmortem
jen: also add a note for CS so they don't tell customers the bad artifact went live
sasha: add a canary run for the pinned image in eu-west before we close the change window
maria: scheduled canary, I'll watch the metrics for next 30m :eyes:
kevin: reopening ticket #INC-2026 with logs attached
maria: summarizing: hold -> manual pin -> promote -> canary -> followups. leaving thread open until canary green
jen: thanks all, updating release doc and closing the blockers section
samir: :rocket:
